text: A POP3 account with about 35,000 messages could time out while processing LIST or UIDL. The reporter saw the event-loop spin stall, with UI activity sometimes unsticking it. A proposed yield every 1000 lines was manually tested on about 38,000 messages without noticed UI slowdown. The issue is not proof that this patch sends more POP3 NOOPs.
title: Bug 1893307 POP3 line processing
